description.text: All the bachelor’s degree programs last for 4 years, operating on the credit system management, i.e. the candidates may choose to shorten or lengthen their academic study period depending on the number of credits acquired.

duration.text: The Chemical Engineering and Technology at Dalian University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2847 USD/per year ￥ 20500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (Optional)

requirements.text: The applicants must 1. hold a high school diploma 2. be in good health 3. be over the age of 18 ※Students would be admitted if he has passed the examinations set by the university in accordance with the program chosen.
